neighbours.label: video-game gameplay discussion (levels, weapons, playthroughs, Xbox, cheats)
fire: On my second playthrough I skipped most side quests and rushed the final boss.
The shotgun is useful on level four because enemies swarm you in tight corridors.
You can unlock a hidden character by beating the arcade mode on hard difficulty.
Online co-op on the PlayStation lets two players tackle each dungeon together.
The sniper rifle respawns near the tower, so grab it before the enemy team does.
Entering the cheat code gives you infinite ammo for the rest of the mission.
Each racing track has shortcuts that shave a few seconds off your lap time.
If you save your mana potions, the last boss fight becomes much easier.
quiet: On my second reading of the novel I skipped most chapters and rushed to the ending.
The shotgun wedding in the film is played for laughs in a crowded chapel.
You can visit a hidden garden by walking behind the old museum on Sundays.
Two players sit across the chessboard and think for several minutes per move.
The tower in the old town was restored after the earthquake last spring.
Entering the building requires a code that changes every month.
Each marathon route has hills that add a few minutes to runners' times.
If you save your receipts, filing taxes at the end of the year becomes much easier.

notes: Card: all top examples are game reviews/guides (shooting rampage on first playthrough, weapon on levels 2 and 3, Xbox Live options, cheats, replayability). The + pole is flagged dense and gate-closed, but the asked - pole is not. Not probed.
